## Motivation

Admission, memory accounting and transfers currently inspect concrete KV pools to discover their resources. Expose those resources through storage so these consumers can handle static and unified layouts consistently.

## Changes

- Read per-subpool capacity and usage through KV storage for admission, statistics and leak checks.
- Route beam-search row allocation and release through storage.
- Register static KV and state transfer descriptors through the same storage interface, preserving transfer ordering and layout metadata.

Clarify storage comments and use `CustomTestCase` for the NPU transfer tests.

## Validation

The cleanup changes comments and the NPU test base class. NPU tests were not rerun; no tests were rerun after the rebase.

All 27 non-Rust pre-commit hooks passed with `--all-files`, including the corrected Ruff formatting check. Rust checks remain unverified locally.

Historical validation through `8269aaa42e` (8× H200, PyTorch 2.14.1):
- gpt-oss-120b observer comparison: **43 gauges and 134 invariant lines identical**.
- Qwen3-4B beam search, widths 2/4/8: **48/48 requests matched**, including output IDs and sequence scores.
- Transfer comparison covered **eight unified and six static configurations**: no differences from the preceding implementation; static descriptors also matched main.
- Four-chain replay: **0 divergences**; admission: **4,608 unchanged decisions**.

Later CPU/source review preserved transfer ordering and restore fences. Full per-run kernel versions were not recorded; live serving/transfer was not rerun on this head.
